Batch 18 draft authoring is complete: 22 A-page items and 4 B-page examples. I added a local isometry lemma with a direct, choice-free proof and clarified the Hamming theorem’s `n=0` metric case. The B-page source map now covers the quantum repetition example against Cleve §36.3.1 and Preskill §7.1; [Preskill’s chapter](https://www.preskill.caltech.edu/ph219/chap7_26_6A.pdf) describes the three-qubit code for one bit-flip error.
